text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On a certain day off. When I arrived at a 
cafe, I ran into Tanino Gimlet.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
...Hm, have you also come to enjoy a Take 
Five?
choice_data_list: Huh? Er, yeah, thought I'd take a break.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thinking it best not to disturb her 
reading, I took a seat further away. Just 
then—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Chime, chime, chime—)

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: ...Whoa there.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
—The king who commands the outlaws. Quite 
the coincidental encounter.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
You're... hah. The supposed God of 
Destruction, huh. Enjoying a pleasant 
little tea party today?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Modern philosophy, is it? —Ah. Is that 
also just another pose you strike to 
intoxicate people?

text_block_list.name: Tani no Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh, clever as ever. It is just as the 
"Bewitching Lady" says. I shall not deny 
it.

text_block_list.name: Tani no Gimlet
text_block_list.text: However, I refuse to be looked down upon.

text_block_list.name: Tani no Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Do you know? How a performer transforms 
into a masked phantom?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Tani no Gimlet
text_block_list.text: The answer is—song.

text_block_list.name: Tani no Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
And costume. Lighting. Staging. Through 
the apparatus of the theater, a mortal 
flesh is endlessly adorned.

text_block_list.name: Tani no Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
The more apparatus, the better. The more 
vivid, the greater the actor's presence...

text_block_list.name: Tani no Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Then, fiction shall eventually become 
reality—! Heheh... Take your seats! Let me 
show you what kind of cards I hold!

text_block_list.name: Tani no Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
For instance— The Metamorphosis of the 
Boundary...

text_block_list.name: Tani no Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
And then— The Transfer to the Next 
Horizon...

text_block_list.name: Tani no Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Until finally— The Elysium to which we 
arrive...!!

text_block_list.name: Tani no Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
AHAHAHAHAHA!!!! My cards are eternally 
infinite!!!!

text_block_list.name: Tani no Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
My colors shall never fade!!!! In other 
words, this is no mere bluff!!!!

text_block_list.name: Tani no Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
An existence forever adorned by theatrical 
apparatus!!!! The contrapposto of fiction 
and fact!!!!

text_block_list.name: Tani no Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Embodying both the illusion and reality 
simultaneously through my cards—THAT is 
who I am!!!!

text_block_list.name: Tani no Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
...Well? Do you understand me now? O King 
of the Heavenly Wolf shining in the night 
sky.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Haha! Hahaha!! Well, that was more 
than I expected!!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Getting that intoxicated over a one-man 
show. If I'm the King of Sirius, then I 
guess you're practically the apostle of 
the god of wine.

text_block_list.name: Tani no Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Are you dissatisfied? If a duel is what 
you desire, I shall gladly accept.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Nah? Just found it amusing. There are 
plenty of fools infatuated with both of 
us.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Being lumped together is annoying, but— I 
see there's no reason for us to fight.

text_block_list.name: Tani no Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
I agree. I seek the crown, but I have no 
need for retainers.

text_block_list.name: Tani no Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
That said... I do not choose who raises a 
chalice. If you desire it, I will 
intoxicate you as much as you wish.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Ha. Sounds great. While you're distracted 
by your cup, I'll go ahead and blow away 
the entire barrel.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I was merely watching, but— ...it was 
quite an intense moment. So much so that 
it left me completely at a loss for words.
